## Stock Entry Detail 业务规则矩阵 (Business Rules Matrix)

### 1. 基础属性与控制规则
*   **模块**: Stock
*   **字段总数**: 67
*   **命名规则 (Naming)**: `hash`
*   **文档类型 (Document Type)**: `Other`
*   **是否可提交 (Is Submittable)**: 否 (No)
*   **DocType 级控制标记**:
    *   editable_grid: Yes
    *   sort_field: `modified`
    *   sort_order: `ASC`
*   **继承基类 (Base Controller)**: `Document`

#### 字段约束条件:
*   **必填字段 (Mandatory)**:
    *   `item_code` (Item Code) [Link]
    *   `qty` (Qty) [Float]
    *   `uom` (UOM) [Link]
    *   `conversion_factor` (Conversion Factor) [Float]
    *   `stock_uom` (Stock UOM) [Link]
    *   `transfer_qty` (Qty as per Stock UOM) [Float]
*   **只读字段 (Read Only)**:
    *   `item_name` (Item Name)
    *   `basic_amount` (Basic Amount)
    *   `additional_cost` (Additional Cost)
    *   `amount` (Amount)
    *   `valuation_rate` (Valuation Rate)
    *   `stock_uom` (Stock UOM)
    *   `transfer_qty` (Qty as per Stock UOM)
    *   `retain_sample` (Retain Sample)
    *   `actual_qty` (Actual Qty (at source/target))
    *   `allow_alternative_item` (Allow Alternative Item)
    *   `material_request` (Material Request)
    *   `material_request_item` (Material Request Item)
    *   `original_item` (Original Item)
    *   `against_stock_entry` (Against Stock Entry)
    *   `ste_detail` (Stock Entry Child)
    *   `transferred_qty` (Transferred Qty)
    *   `reference_purchase_receipt` (Reference Purchase Receipt)
    *   `po_detail` (PO Supplied Item)
    *   `sco_rm_detail` (SCO Supplied Item)
    *   `putaway_rule` (Putaway Rule)
    *   `job_card_item` (Job Card Item)
    *   `has_item_scanned` (Has Item Scanned)
*   **条件只读字段**:
    *   `allow_zero_valuation_rate` (Allow Zero Valuation Rate) depends on: `eval:doc.s_warehouse`
*   **隐藏字段 (Hidden)**:
    *   `image` (Image)
    *   `bom_no` (BOM No)
    *   `material_request` (Material Request)
    *   `material_request_item` (Material Request Item)
    *   `original_item` (Original Item)
    *   `po_detail` (PO Supplied Item)
    *   `sco_rm_detail` (SCO Supplied Item)
    *   `job_card_item` (Job Card Item)
*   **自动带入规则 (Fetch From)**:
    *   `retain_sample` (Retain Sample) <- `item_code.retain_sample`
    *   `item_group` (Item Group) <- `item_code.item_group`
*   **动态可见性与条件控制 (Depends On)**:
    *   `conversion_factor` (Conversion Factor) depends on: `eval:doc.uom != doc.stock_uom`
    *   `stock_uom` (Stock UOM) depends on: `eval:doc.uom != doc.stock_uom`
    *   `transfer_qty` (Qty as per Stock UOM) depends on: `eval:doc.uom != doc.stock_uom`
    *   `sample_quantity` (Sample Quantity) depends on: `retain_sample`
    *   `quality_inspection` (Quality Inspection) depends on: `eval:parent.inspection_required && doc.t_warehouse`
    *   `expense_account` (Difference Account) depends on: `eval:cint(erpnext.is_perpetual_inventory_enabled(parent.company))`
    *   `cost_center` (Cost Center) depends on: `eval:cint(erpnext.is_perpetual_inventory_enabled(parent.company))`
    *   `allow_alternative_item` (Allow Alternative Item) depends on: `s_warehouse`
    *   `subcontracted_item` (Subcontracted Item) depends on: `eval:parent.purpose == 'Send to Subcontractor'`
    *   `set_basic_rate_manually` (Set Basic Rate Manually) depends on: `eval:parent.purpose==="Repack" && doc.t_warehouse`
    *   `putaway_rule` (Putaway Rule) depends on: `eval:in_list(["Material Transfer", "Material Receipt"], parent.purpose)`
    *   `has_item_scanned` (Has Item Scanned) depends on: `barcode`
*   **提交后仍可修改**:
    *   `actual_qty` (Actual Qty (at source/target))
*   **复制时不带出**:
    *   `serial_no_batch` (Serial No / Batch)
    *   `serial_no` (Serial No)
    *   `batch_no` (Batch No)
    *   `quality_inspection` (Quality Inspection)
    *   `allow_zero_valuation_rate` (Allow Zero Valuation Rate)
    *   `actual_qty` (Actual Qty (at source/target))
    *   `material_request` (Material Request)
    *   `material_request_item` (Material Request Item)
    *   `original_item` (Original Item)
    *   `against_stock_entry` (Against Stock Entry)
    *   `ste_detail` (Stock Entry Child)
    *   `transferred_qty` (Transferred Qty)
    *   `po_detail` (PO Supplied Item)
    *   `sco_rm_detail` (SCO Supplied Item)
    *   `putaway_rule` (Putaway Rule)
    *   `job_card_item` (Job Card Item)
*   **列表视图字段**:
    *   `s_warehouse` (Source Warehouse)
    *   `t_warehouse` (Target Warehouse)
    *   `item_code` (Item Code)
    *   `qty` (Qty)
    *   `basic_rate` (Basic Rate (as per Stock UOM))
*   **默认值 (Default)**:
    *   `retain_sample` (Retain Sample) = `0`
    *   `cost_center` (Cost Center) = `:Company`
    *   `allow_zero_valuation_rate` (Allow Zero Valuation Rate) = `0`
    *   `allow_alternative_item` (Allow Alternative Item) = `0`
    *   `set_basic_rate_manually` (Set Basic Rate Manually) = `0`
    *   `is_scrap_item` (Is Scrap Item) = `0`
    *   `is_finished_item` (Is Finished Item) = `0`
    *   `is_process_loss` (Is Process Loss) = `0`
    *   `has_item_scanned` (Has Item Scanned) = `0`
*   **字段选项 (Options)**:
    *   `s_warehouse` (Source Warehouse) options: `Warehouse`
    *   `t_warehouse` (Target Warehouse) options: `Warehouse`
    *   `item_code` (Item Code) options: `Item`
    *   `uom` (UOM) options: `UOM`
    *   `stock_uom` (Stock UOM) options: `UOM`
    *   `batch_no` (Batch No) options: `Batch`
    *   `quality_inspection` (Quality Inspection) options: `Quality Inspection`
    *   `expense_account` (Difference Account) options: `Account`
    *   `cost_center` (Cost Center) options: `Cost Center`
    *   `bom_no` (BOM No) options: `BOM`
    *   `material_request` (Material Request) options: `Material Request`
    *   `material_request_item` (Material Request Item) options: `Material Request Item`
    *   `original_item` (Original Item) options: `Item`
    *   `subcontracted_item` (Subcontracted Item) options: `Item`
    *   `against_stock_entry` (Against Stock Entry) options: `Stock Entry`
    *   `reference_purchase_receipt` (Reference Purchase Receipt) options: `Purchase Receipt`
    *   `project` (Project) options: `Project`

### 2. 前置校验与约束条件 (Validation Rules)
#### `validate` 生命钩子执行校验流:
在该钩子中按源码顺序列出了以下内部校验/处理函数（实际执行可能受条件分支影响）:
1.  `self.validate_mandatory()`
1.  `self.validate_item()`
1.  `self.validate_batch()`
1.  `self.scrub_posting_time()`
1.  `self.validate_and_set_fiscal_year()`
1.  `self.block_transactions_against_group_warehouse()`
1.  `self.validate_with_last_transaction_posting_time()`

#### 核心控制校验函数与报错信息:
*   `on_submit`:
    *   调用链:
        *   `self.check_stock_frozen_date()`
        *   `self.calculate_batch_qty()`
        *   `self.get()`
*   `validate_mandatory`:
    *   调用链:
        *   `self.get()`
    *   条件: `not self.get(k)`
    *   **[Throw]**: _('{0} is required').format(self.meta.get_label(k))
    *   条件: `self.voucher_type != 'Stock Reconciliation' and (not self.actual_qty)`
    *   **[Throw]**: Actual Qty is mandatory
*   `validate_item`:
    *   条件: `not item_det`
    *   **[Throw]**: _('Item {0} not found').format(self.item_code)
    *   条件: `item_det.is_stock_item != 1`
    *   **[Throw]**: _('Item {0} must be a stock Item').format(self.item_code)
    *   条件: `item_det.has_batch_no == 1 && not self.batch_no`
    *   **[Throw]**: _('Batch number is mandatory for Item {0}').format(batch_item)
    *   条件: `item_det.has_batch_no == 1 && not (not self.batch_no) && not frappe.db.get_value('Batch', {'item': self.item_code, 'name': self.batch_no})`
    *   **[Throw]**: _('{0} is not a valid Batch Number for Item {1}').format(self.batch_no, batch_item)
    *   条件: `not (item_det.has_batch_no == 1) && item_det.has_batch_no == 0 and self.batch_no and (self.is_cancelled == 0)`
    *   **[Throw]**: _('The Item {0} cannot have Batch').format(self.item_code)
    *   条件: `item_det.has_variants`
    *   **[Throw]**: _('Stock cannot exist for Item {0} since has variants').format(self.item_code)
*   `check_stock_frozen_date`:
    *   条件: `stock_settings.stock_frozen_upto && getdate(self.posting_date) <= getdate(stock_settings.stock_frozen_upto) and stock_settings.stock_auth_role not in frappe.get_roles()`
    *   **[Throw]**: _('Stock transactions before {0} are frozen').format(formatdate(stock_settings.stock_frozen_upto))
    *   条件: `stock_frozen_upto_days && older_than_x_days_ago and stock_settings.stock_auth_role not in frappe.get_roles()`
    *   **[Throw]**: _('Not allowed to update stock transactions older than {0}').format(stock_frozen_upto_days)
*   `validate_batch`:
    *   条件: `self.batch_no and self.voucher_type != 'Stock Entry' && expiry_date && getdate(self.posting_date) > getdate(expiry_date)`
    *   **[Throw]**: _('Batch {0} of Item {1} has expired.').format(self.batch_no, self.item_code)
*   `validate_and_set_fiscal_year`:
    *   执行特定条件判定 (无硬性抛错/动态抛错)
*   `validate_with_last_transaction_posting_time`:
    *   调用链:
        *   `self.get()`
    *   条件: `authorized_role && authorized_users and frappe.session.user not in authorized_users && last_transaction_time and get_datetime(cur_doc_posting_datetime) < get_datetime(last_transaction_time)`
    *   **[Throw]**: Backdated Stock Entry
*   `on_cancel`:
    *   **[Throw]**: msg
*   `on_doctype_update`:
    *   执行特定条件判定 (无硬性抛错/动态抛错)

### 3. 后置联动与过账逻辑 (Execution / Submission Rules)
*   `on_submit`:
    *   调用链:
        *   `self.check_stock_frozen_date()`
        *   `self.calculate_batch_qty()`
        *   `self.get()`

### 4. 逆向/作废控制规则 (Cancellation Rules)
*   `on_cancel`:
    *   **[Throw]**: msg

### 5. 前端交互与客户端规则 (Client-Side Interactivity)
#### 页面绑定: `Stock Ledger Entry`
*   **生命周期触发器**: `refresh`

### 1. 基础属性与控制规则
*   **模块**: Stock

*   **命名规则 (Naming)**: `naming_series:`
*   **文档类型 (Document Type)**: `Document`

*   **DocType 级控制标记**:

#### 字段约束条件:
*   **必填字段 (Mandatory)**:
    *   `naming_series` (Series) [Select]
    *   `company` (Company) [Link]
    *   `purpose` (Purpose) [Select]
    *   `posting_date` (Posting Date) [Date]
    *   `posting_time` (Posting Time) [Time]
    *   `items` (Items) [Table]
*   **只读字段 (Read Only)**:

    *   `section_break_22` (section_break_22) depends on: `eval:!doc.docstatus`
*   **仅允许设置一次**:
    *   `naming_series` (Series)
*   **复制时不带出**:
    *   `naming_series` (Series)

    *   `posting_date` (Posting Date)

    *   `set_posting_time` (Edit Posting Date and Time) = `0`

*   **字段选项 (Options)**:
    *   `naming_series` (Series) options: `MAT-RECO-.YYYY.-`

    *   `purpose` (Purpose) options: `
Opening Stock
Stock Reconciliation`
    *   `items` (Items) options: `Stock Reconciliation Item`
    *   `expense_account` (Difference Account) options: `Account`
    *   `cost_center` (Cost Center) options: `Cost Center`
    *   `amended_from` (Amended From) options: `Stock Reconciliation`
    *   `set_warehouse` (Default Warehouse) options: `Warehouse`

### 2. 前置校验与约束条件 (Validation Rules)
#### `validate` 生命钩子执行校验流:
在该钩子中按源码顺序列出了以下内部校验/处理函数（实际执行可能受条件分支影响）:
1.  `self.validate_posting_time()`
1.  `self.remove_items_with_no_change()`
1.  `self.validate_data()`
1.  `self.validate_expense_account()`
1.  `self.validate_customer_provided_item()`
1.  `self.set_zero_value_for_customer_provided_items()`
1.  `self.clean_serial_nos()`
1.  `self.set_total_qty_and_amount()`
1.  `self.validate_putaway_capacity()`
1.  `self.make_batches()`

#### 核心控制校验函数与报错信息:
*   `on_submit`:
    *   调用链:
        *   `self.update_stock_ledger()`
        *   `self.make_gl_entries()`
        *   `self.repost_future_sle_and_gle()`
*   `on_cancel`:
    *   调用链:
        *   `self.make_sle_on_cancel()`
        *   `self.make_gl_entries_on_cancel()`
        *   `self.repost_future_sle_and_gle()`
        *   `self.delete_auto_created_batches()`
*   `remove_items_with_no_change`:
    *   条件: `not items`
    *   **[Throw]**: None of the items have any change in quantity or value.
    *   条件: `not (not items) && len(items) != len(self.items)`
    *   **[Msgprint]**: Removed items with no change in quantity or value.
*   `validate_data`:
    *   调用链:
        *   `self.validate_item()`
    *   条件: `self.validation_messages`
    *   **[Msgprint]**: msg
    *   条件: `self.validation_messages`
    *   **[Raise]**: self.validation_messages
*   `validate_item`:
    *   条件: `item.has_serial_no and (not row.serial_no) and (not item.serial_no_series)`
    *   **[Raise]**: _('Serial no(s) required for serialized item {0}').format(item_code)
    *   条件: `item.has_batch_no and (not row.batch_no) and (not item.create_new_batch)`
    *   **[Raise]**: _('Batch no is required for batched item {0}').format(item_code)
*   `update_stock_ledger`:
    *   调用链:
        *   `self.get_sle_for_serialized_items()`
        *   `self.get_sle_for_items()`
        *   `self.merge_similar_item_serial_nos()`
        *   `self.make_sl_entries()`
        *   `self.update_valuation_rate_for_serial_no()`
    *   条件: `not (item.has_serial_no or item.has_batch_no) && row.serial_no or row.batch_no`
    *   **[Throw]**: _('Row #{0}: Item {1} is not a Serialized/Batched Item. It cannot have a Serial No/Batch No against it.').format(row.idx, frappe.bold(row.item_code))
    *   条件: `not (item.has_serial_no or item.has_batch_no) && row.qty and (not row.valuation_rate) and (not row.allow_zero_valuation_rate)`
    *   **[Throw]**: _('Valuation Rate required for Item {0} at row {1}').format(row.item_code, row.idx)
*   `get_gl_entries`:
    *   条件: `not self.cost_center`
    *   **[Msgprint]**: Please enter Cost Center
*   `validate_expense_account`:
    *   条件: `not self.expense_account`
    *   **[Throw]**: Please enter Expense Account
    *   条件: `not (not self.expense_account) && self.purpose == 'Opening Stock' or not frappe.db.sql('select name from `tabStock Ledger Entry` limit 1') && frappe.db.get_value('Account', self.expense_account, 'report_type') == 'Profit and Loss'`
    *   **[Throw]**: Difference Account must be a Asset/Liability type account, since this Stock Reconciliation is an Opening Entry
*   `set_zero_value_for_customer_provided_items`:
    *   调用链:
        *   `self.get()`
    *   条件: `changed_any_values`
    *   **[Msgprint]**: Valuation rate for customer provided items has been set to zero. | Note | blue
*   `set_total_qty_and_amount`:
    *   调用链:
        *   `self.get()`
*   `submit`:
    *   调用链:
        *   `self.queue_action()`
        *   `self._submit()`
    *   条件: `len(self.items) > 100`
    *   **[Msgprint]**: The task has been enqueued as a background job. In case there is any issue on processing in background, the system will add a comment about the error on this Stock Reconciliation and revert to the Draft stage
*   `cancel`:
    *   调用链:
        *   `self.queue_action()`
        *   `self._cancel()`
    *   条件: `len(self.items) > 100`
    *   **[Msgprint]**: The task has been enqueued as a background job. In case there is any issue on processing in background, the system will add a comment about the error on this Stock Reconciliation and revert to the Submitted stage
*   `get_stock_balance_for`:
    *   条件: `not item_dict`
    *   **[Throw]**: Missing

### 3. 后置联动与过账逻辑 (Execution / Submission Rules)
*   `on_submit`:
    *   调用链:
        *   `self.update_stock_ledger()`
        *   `self.make_gl_entries()`
        *   `self.repost_future_sle_and_gle()`

### 4. 逆向/作废控制规则 (Cancellation Rules)
*   `on_cancel`:
    *   逆向联动回滚函数:
        *   `self.make_sle_on_cancel()`
        *   `self.make_gl_entries_on_cancel()`
        *   `self.repost_future_sle_and_gle()`
        *   `self.delete_auto_created_batches()`

直属校验结果:

    *   调用链:

    *   条件: `frappe.db.get_value('Warehouse', self.get(field), 'is_group')`
    *   **[Throw]**: Incorrect Warehouse
*   `cant_change_valuation_method`:
    *   条件: `db_valuation_method and db_valuation_method != self.valuation_method && sle`
    *   **[Throw]**: Can't change the valuation method, as there are transactions against some items which do not have its own valuation method
*   `validate_clean_description_html`:
    *   调用链:
        *   `self.db_get()`
*   `validate_pending_reposts`:
    *   执行特定条件判定 (无硬性抛错/动态抛错)
*   `on_update`:
    *   调用链:
        *   `self.toggle_warehouse_field_for_inter_warehouse_transfer()`

### 2. 前置校验与约束条件 (Validation Rules)
#### `validate` 生命钩子执行校验流:
在该钩子中按源码顺序列出了以下内部校验/处理函数（实际执行可能受条件分支影响）:
1.  `self.warn_about_multiple_warehouse_account()`

#### 核心控制校验函数与报错信息:
*   `on_update`:
    *   调用链:
        *   `self.update_nsm_model()`
*   `on_trash`:
    *   调用链:
        *   `self.check_if_sle_exists()`
        *   `self.check_if_child_exists()`
        *   `self.update_nsm_model()`
        *   `self.unlink_from_items()`
    *   条件: `d['actual_qty'] or d['reserved_qty'] or d['ordered_qty'] or d['indented_qty'] or d['projected_qty'] or d['planned_qty']`
    *   **[Throw]**: _('Warehouse {0} can not be deleted as quantity exists for Item {1}').format(self.name, d['item_code'])
    *   条件: `self.check_if_sle_exists()`
    *   **[Throw]**: Warehouse can not be deleted as stock ledger entry exists for this warehouse.
    *   条件: `self.check_if_child_exists()`
    *   **[Throw]**: Child warehouse exists for this warehouse. You can not delete this warehouse.
*   `warn_about_multiple_warehouse_account`:
    *   调用链:
        *   `self.is_new()`
    *   条件: `self.account != old_wh_account`
    *   **[Msgprint]**: Multiple Warehouse Accounts | orange
*   `check_if_sle_exists`:
    *   执行特定条件判定 (无硬性抛错/动态抛错)
*   `check_if_child_exists`:
    *   执行特定条件判定 (无硬性抛错/动态抛错)
*   `convert_to_ledger`:
    *   调用链:
        *   `self.check_if_child_exists()`
        *   `self.check_if_sle_exists()`
        *   `self.save()`
    *   条件: `self.check_if_child_exists()`
    *   **[Throw]**: Warehouses with child nodes cannot be converted to ledger
    *   条件: `not (self.check_if_child_exists()) && self.check_if_sle_exists()`
    *   **[Throw]**: Warehouses with existing transaction can not be converted to ledger.
*   `convert_to_group`:
    *   调用链:
        *   `self.check_if_sle_exists()`
        *   `self.save()`
    *   条件: `self.check_if_sle_exists()`
    *   **[Throw]**: Warehouses with existing transaction can not be converted to group.
*   `get_warehouses_based_on_account`:
    *   条件: `not warehouses`
    *   **[Throw]**: _('Warehouse not found against the account {0}').format(account)

### 2. 前置校验与约束条件 (Validation Rules)
#### `validate` 生命钩子执行校验流:
在该钩子中按源码顺序列出了以下内部校验/处理函数（实际执行可能受条件分支影响）:
1.  `self.validate_purchase_order_for_subcontracting()`
1.  `self.validate_items()`
1.  `self.validate_service_items()`
1.  `self.validate_supplied_items()`
1.  `self.set_missing_values()`
1.  `self.reset_default_field_value()`

#### 核心控制校验函数与报错信息:
*   `before_validate`:
    *   执行特定条件判定 (无硬性抛错/动态抛错)
*   `on_submit`:
    *   调用链:
        *   `self.update_ordered_qty_for_subcontracting()`
        *   `self.update_reserved_qty_for_subcontracting()`
        *   `self.update_status()`
*   `on_cancel`:
    *   调用链:
        *   `self.update_ordered_qty_for_subcontracting()`
        *   `self.update_reserved_qty_for_subcontracting()`
        *   `self.update_status()`
*   `validate_purchase_order_for_subcontracting`:
    *   条件: `self.purchase_order && is_subcontracting_order_created(self.purchase_order)`
    *   **[Throw]**: Only one Subcontracting Order can be created against a Purchase Order, cancel the existing Subcontracting Order to create a new one.
    *   条件: `self.purchase_order && not po.is_subcontracted`
    *   **[Throw]**: Please select a valid Purchase Order that is configured for Subcontracting.
    *   条件: `self.purchase_order && po.is_old_subcontracting_flow`
    *   **[Throw]**: Please select a valid Purchase Order that has Service Items.
    *   条件: `self.purchase_order && po.docstatus != 1`
    *   **[Throw]**: _(msg)
    *   条件: `self.purchase_order && po.per_received == 100`
    *   **[Throw]**: _(msg)
    *   条件: `not (self.purchase_order)`
    *   **[Throw]**: Please select a Subcontracting Purchase Order.
*   `validate_service_items`:
    *   条件: `frappe.get_value('Item', item.item_code, 'is_stock_item')`
    *   **[Throw]**: _(msg)
*   `validate_supplied_items`:
    *   条件: `self.supplier_warehouse && self.supplier_warehouse == item.reserve_warehouse`
    *   **[Throw]**: _(msg)
*   `set_missing_values`:
    *   调用链:
        *   `self.set_missing_values_in_additional_costs()`
        *   `self.set_missing_values_in_service_items()`
        *   `self.set_missing_values_in_supplied_items()`
        *   `self.set_missing_values_in_items()`
*   `set_missing_values_in_service_items`:
    *   调用链:
        *   `self.get()`
*   `set_missing_values_in_supplied_items`:
    *   调用链:
        *   `self.get()`
*   `set_missing_values_in_items`:
    *   执行特定条件判定 (无硬性抛错/动态抛错)
*   `populate_items_table`:
    *   调用链:
        *   `self.append()`
        *   `self.set_missing_values()`
    *   条件: `not (si.fg_item)`
    *   **[Throw]**: _('Please select Finished Good Item for Service Item {0}').format(si.item_name or si.item_code)

### 3. 后置联动与过账逻辑 (Execution / Submission Rules)
*   `on_submit`:
    *   调用链:
        *   `self.update_ordered_qty_for_subcontracting()`
        *   `self.update_reserved_qty_for_subcontracting()`
        *   `self.update_status()`

### 4. 逆向/作废控制规则 (Cancellation Rules)
*   `on_cancel`:
    *   逆向联动回滚函数:
        *   `self.update_ordered_qty_for_subcontracting()`
        *   `self.update_reserved_qty_for_subcontracting()`
        *   `self.update_status()`

### 5. 前端交互与客户端规则 (Client-Side Interactivity)
#### 页面绑定: `Subcontracting Order`
#### 页面绑定: `Landed Cost Taxes and Charges`
*   **字段值变更触发事件 (Field Listeners)**:
    *   `amount` 字段改变时触发前端计算或联动
    *   `expense_account` 字段改变时触发前端计算或联动

### 2. 前置校验与约束条件 (Validation Rules)
#### `validate` 生命钩子执行校验流:
在该钩子中按源码顺序列出了以下内部校验/处理函数（实际执行可能受条件分支影响）:
1.  `self.set_missing_values()`
1.  `self.validate_posting_time()`
1.  `self.validate_rejected_warehouse()`
1.  `self.make_batches()`
1.  `self.reset_default_field_value()`
1.  `self.get_current_stock()`
直属校验结果:
    *   条件: `getdate(self.posting_date) > getdate(nowdate())`
    *   **[Throw]**: Posting Date cannot be future date

#### 核心控制校验函数与报错信息:
*   `before_validate`:
    *   调用链:
        *   `self.set_items_bom()`
        *   `self.set_items_cost_center()`
        *   `self.set_items_expense_account()`
*   `on_submit`:
    *   调用链:
        *   `self.validate_available_qty_for_consumption()`
        *   `self.update_status_updater_args()`
        *   `self.update_prevdoc_status()`
        *   `self.set_subcontracting_order_status()`
        *   `self.set_consumed_qty_in_subcontract_order()`
        *   `self.update_stock_ledger()`
        *   `self.make_gl_entries()`
        *   `self.repost_future_sle_and_gle()`
        *   `self.update_status()`
*   `on_cancel`:
    *   调用链:
        *   `self.update_status_updater_args()`
        *   `self.update_prevdoc_status()`
        *   `self.update_stock_ledger()`
        *   `self.make_gl_entries_on_cancel()`
        *   `self.repost_future_sle_and_gle()`
        *   `self.delete_auto_created_batches()`
        *   `self.set_consumed_qty_in_subcontract_order()`
        *   `self.set_subcontracting_order_status()`
        *   `self.update_status()`
*   `set_missing_values`:
    *   调用链:
        *   `self.set_missing_values_in_additional_costs()`
        *   `self.set_missing_values_in_supplied_items()`
        *   `self.set_missing_values_in_items()`
*   `set_available_qty_for_consumption`:
    *   调用链:
        *   `self.get()`
*   `set_missing_values_in_supplied_items`:
    *   调用链:
        *   `self.get()`
        *   `self.set_available_qty_for_consumption()`
*   `set_missing_values_in_items`:
    *   调用链:
        *   `self.get()`
*   `validate_rejected_warehouse`:
    *   条件: `not self.rejected_warehouse && item.rejected_qty`
    *   **[Throw]**: _('Rejected Warehouse is mandatory against rejected Item {0}').format(item.item_code)
*   `validate_available_qty_for_consumption`:
    *   调用链:
        *   `self.get()`
    *   条件: `item.available_qty_for_consumption and item.available_qty_for_consumption < item.consumed_qty`
    *   **[Throw]**: _('Row {0}: Consumed Qty must be less than or equal to Available Qty For Consumption in Consumed Items Table.').format(item.idx)
*   `set_items_bom`:
    *   执行特定条件判定 (无硬性抛错/动态抛错)
*   `set_items_cost_center`:
    *   执行特定条件判定 (无硬性抛错/动态抛错)
*   `set_items_expense_account`:
    *   调用链:
        *   `self.get_company_default()`
*   `make_item_gl_entries`:
    *   调用链:
        *   `self.get_company_default()`
        *   `self.get()`
        *   `self.add_gl_entry()`
    *   条件: `warehouse_with_no_account`
    *   **[Msgprint]**: No accounting entries for the following warehouses | :

    *   `holiday_list` (Holiday List) [Link]
    *   `support_and_resolution` (Working Hours) [Table]
    *   `priorities` (Priorities) [Table]
    *   `document_type` (Apply On) [Link]
    *   `sla_fulfilled_on` (SLA Fulfilled On) [Table]
*   **只读字段 (Read Only)**:

*   **动态可见性与条件控制 (Depends On)**:

    *   `column_break_7` (column_break_7) depends on: `eval: !doc.default_contract`
    *   `entity` (Entity) depends on: `eval: !doc.default_service_level_agreement`
    *   `entity_type` (Entity Type) depends on: `eval: !doc.default_service_level_agreement`
    *   `status_details` (Status Details) depends on: `document_type`
    *   `filters_section` (Assignment Conditions) depends on: `document_type`
    *   `condition` (Condition) depends on: `eval: !doc.default_service_level_agreement`
*   **仅允许设置一次**:
    *   `service_level` (Service Level Name)
    *   `document_type` (Apply On)
*   **列表视图字段**:
    *   `service_level` (Service Level Name)
    *   `entity` (Entity)
*   **标准筛选字段**:
    *   `service_level` (Service Level Name)
    *   `entity` (Entity)
    *   `entity_type` (Entity Type)
*   **默认值 (Default)**:
    *   `default_service_level_agreement` (Default Service Level Agreement) = `0`

Customer

    *   `sla_fulfilled_on` (SLA Fulfilled On) options: `SLA Fulfilled On Status`

### 2. 前置校验与约束条件 (Validation Rules)
#### `validate` 生命钩子执行校验流:
在该钩子中按源码顺序列出了以下内部校验/处理函数（实际执行可能受条件分支影响）:
1.  `self.validate_selected_doctype()`
1.  `self.validate_doc()`
1.  `self.validate_status_field()`
1.  `self.check_priorities()`
1.  `self.check_support_and_resolution()`
1.  `self.validate_condition()`

#### 核心控制校验函数与报错信息:
*   `check_priorities`:
    *   条件: `not priority.response_time`
    *   **[Throw]**: _('Set Response Time for Priority {0} in row {1}.').format(priority.priority, priority.idx)
    *   条件: `self.apply_sla_for_resolution && not priority.resolution_time`
    *   **[Throw]**: _('Set Response Time for Priority {0} in row {1}.').format(priority.priority, priority.idx)
    *   条件: `self.apply_sla_for_resolution && response > resolution`
    *   **[Throw]**: _("Response Time for {0} priority in row {1} can't be greater than Resolution Time.").format(priority.priority, priority.idx)
    *   条件: `not len(set(priorities)) == len(priorities)`
    *   **[Throw]**: _('Priority {0} has been repeated.').format(repeated_priority)
    *   条件: `except Exception`
    *   **[Throw]**: Select a Default Priority.
*   `check_support_and_resolution`:
    *   条件: `to_timedelta(support_and_resolution.start_time) >= to_timedelta(support_and_resolution.end_time)`
    *   **[Throw]**: _("Start Time can't be greater than or equal to End Time for {0}.").format(support_and_resolution.workday)
    *   条件: `not len(set(support_days)) == len(support_days)`
    *   **[Throw]**: _('Workday {0} has been repeated.').format(repeated_days)
*   `validate_doc`:
    *   调用链:
        *   `self.validate_from_to_dates()`
    *   条件: `self.enabled and self.document_type == 'Issue' and (not frappe.db.get_single_value('Support Settings', 'track_service_level_agreement'))`
    *   **[Throw]**: Track Service Level Agreement | Support Settings | Support Settings
    *   条件: `self.default_service_level_agreement and frappe.db.exists('Service Level Agreement', {'document_type': self.document_type, 'default_service_level_agreement': '1', 'name': ['!=', self.name]})`
    *   **[Throw]**: _('Default Service Level Agreement for {0} already exists.').format(self.document_type)
    *   条件: `self.entity_type and self.entity and frappe.db.exists('Service Level Agreement', {'entity_type': self.entity_type, 'entity': self.entity, 'name': ['!=', self.name]})`
    *   **[Throw]**: _('Service Level Agreement for {0} {1} already exists.').format(frappe.bold(self.entity_type), frappe.bold(self.entity))
*   `validate_selected_doctype`:
    *   条件: `self.document_type not in valid_document_types`
    *   **[Throw]**: Please select valid document type. | Invalid Document Type
*   `validate_status_field`:
    *   条件: `not meta.get_field('status')`
    *   **[Throw]**: _('The Document Type {0} must have a Status field to configure Service Level Agreement').format(frappe.bold(self.document_type))
*   `validate_condition`:
    *   条件: `self.condition && except Exception`
    *   **[Throw]**: _("The Condition '{0}' is invalid").format(self.condition)
*   `before_insert`:
    *   调用链:
        *   `self.create_docfields()`
        *   `self.create_custom_fields()`
*   `on_trash`:
    *   执行特定条件判定 (无硬性抛错/动态抛错)
*   `after_insert`:
    *   执行特定条件判定 (无硬性抛错/动态抛错)
*   `on_update`:
    *   执行特定条件判定 (无硬性抛错/动态抛错)
*   `check_agreement_status`:
    *   执行特定条件判定 (无硬性抛错/动态抛错)
*   `set_documents_with_active_service_level_agreement`:
    *   执行特定条件判定 (无硬性抛错/动态抛错)
*   `get_allotted_seconds`:
    *   条件: `not (parameter == 'response') && not (parameter == 'resolution')`
    *   **[Throw]**: _('{0} parameter is invalid').format(parameter)
*   `set_resolution_time`:
    *   执行特定条件判定 (无硬性抛错/动态抛错)
*   `change_service_level_agreement_and_priority`:
    *   调用链:
        *   `self.set_response_and_resolution_time()`
    *   条件: `self.service_level_agreement and frappe.db.exists('Issue', self.name) and frappe.db.get_single_value('Support Settings', 'track_service_level_agreement') && not self.priority == frappe.db.get_value('Issue', self.name, 'priority')`
    *   **[Msgprint]**: _('Priority has been changed to {0}.').format(self.priority)
    *   条件: `self.service_level_agreement and frappe.db.exists('Issue', self.name) and frappe.db.get_single_value('Support Settings', 'track_service_level_agreement') && not self.service_level_agreement == frappe.db.get_value('Issue', self.name, 'service_level_agreement')`
    *   **[Msgprint]**: _('Service Level Agreement has been changed to {0}.').format(self.service_level_agreement)
*   `reset_service_level_agreement`:
    *   条件: `not frappe.db.get_single_value('Support Settings', 'allow_resetting_service_level_agreement')`
    *   **[Throw]**: Allow Resetting Service Level Agreement from Support Settings.
*   `on_communication_update`:
    *   执行特定条件判定 (无硬性抛错/动态抛错)
*   `set_response_by`:
    *   执行特定条件判定 (无硬性抛错/动态抛错)
*   `set_resolution_by`:
    *   执行特定条件判定 (无硬性抛错/动态抛错)

### 3. 后置联动与过账逻辑 (Execution / Submission Rules)
*   `before_insert`:
    *   调用链:
        *   `self.create_docfields()`
        *   `self.create_custom_fields()`

### 4. 逆向/作废控制规则 (Cancellation Rules)
该单据无特定的 `on_cancel` 作废/回滚逻辑。

### 5. 前端交互与客户端规则 (Client-Side Interactivity)
